task: R5 ability-disabled ritual and stopped-turn exclusion

t:b217690ae52bfb13.title: %s actual mental attack distinguishes character ability disable from inability to perform the ritual
t:b217690ae52bfb13.bindingNote: Actual Confusion on Uonos and failed own-turn recovery retain ability-disabled. Physical ritual remains usable and transforms/heals without clearing the disabling status. Engine JSON replay, DO every command eviction/receipt replay or browser controls/reloads according to layer. No direct status injection.
